# x86-64 encoding goldens: instruction | bytes from clang | relocations.
# The bytes and relocations are generated by gen_golden.py (clang, Intel
# syntax); edit only the left column and rerun it. Relocations are
# offset:kind:addend; reloc fields are masked when comparing bytes.

# ALU register, register at every width, incl. r8-r15 and spl..dil

cvttsd2si eax, qword ptr [rbp - 8]             | f2 0f 2c 45 f8
cvtsd2si eax, xmm0                             | f2 0f 2d c0
cvtsd2si rax, xmm1                             | f2 48 0f 2d c1
cvttss2si eax, xmm0                            | f3 0f 2c c0
cvttss2si rax, dword ptr [rax]                 | f3 48 0f 2c 00
cvtss2si eax, xmm0                             | f3 0f 2d c0
cvtss2sd xmm0, xmm1                            | f3 0f 5a c1
cvtss2sd xmm0, dword ptr [rax]                 | f3 0f 5a 00
cvtsd2ss xmm0, xmm1                            | f2 0f 5a c1
cvtsd2ss xmm9, qword ptr [rax]                 | f2 44 0f 5a 08

# GPR <-> XMM
movq xmm0, rax                                 | 66 48 0f 6e c0
movq rax, xmm0                                 | 66 48 0f 7e c0
movq xmm8, r9                                  | 66 4d 0f 6e c1
movq r10, xmm11                                | 66 4d 0f 7e da
movq xmm0, xmm1                                | f3 0f 7e c1
movq xmm0, qword ptr [rax]                     | f3 0f 7e 00
movq qword ptr [rax], xmm0                     | 66 0f d6 00
movq xmm9, qword ptr [rip + _x]                | f3 44 0f 7e 0d 00 00 00 00 | 5:pc32:-4
movd xmm0, eax                                 | 66 0f 6e c0
movd eax, xmm0                                 | 66 0f 7e c0
movd xmm8, r9d                                 | 66 45 0f 6e c1
movd xmm0, dword ptr [rax]                     | 66 0f 6e 00
movd dword ptr [rax], xmm0                     | 66 0f 7e 00

# SSE logic and rounding
xorpd xmm0, xmm0                               | 66 0f 57 c0
xorpd xmm0, xmmword ptr [rip + _x]             | 66 0f 57 05 00 00 00 00 | 4:pc32:-4
andpd xmm0, xmm1                               | 66 0f 54 c1
andnpd xmm0, xmm1                              | 66 0f 55 c1
orpd xmm0, xmm1                                | 66 0f 56 c1
xorps xmm0, xmm0                               | 0f 57 c0
andps xmm8, xmm9                               | 45 0f 54 c1
andnps xmm0, xmm1                              | 0f 55 c1
orps xmm0, xmm1                                | 0f 56 c1
roundsd xmm0, xmm1, 3                          | 66 0f 3a 0b c1 03
roundsd xmm0, qword ptr [rax], 1               | 66 0f 3a 0b 00 01
roundsd xmm0, qword ptr [rip + _x], 2          | 66 0f 3a 0b 05 ff ff ff ff 02 | 5:pc32:-5
roundss xmm0, xmm1, 4                          | 66 0f 3a 0a c1 04
roundsd xmm9, xmm10, 9                         | 66 45 0f 3a 0b ca 09
